node.title: Budget-three split-fiber atlas
node.statement: Every B*=3 split-pencil witness lies in one of thirteen exact edge-degree chambers; the pendant type has at least one genuinely quadratic edge. Five of the six incidence types contain an explicit total of thirteen three-member constant split pencils. Each degree-d pencil uses three of at most four fully subgroup-split members, as does each degree-(d-1) pencil for d>=6. The cycle is the unique type with no deficit-free split pencil. The residual coupling and adjacent crossing remain open.
